annotation.title_clean: Thailand's CAAT Allows Nationwide Drone Flights with Safety Rules
annotation.title_en: Thailand's CAAT Allows Nationwide Drone Flights with Safety Rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Unknown news outlet (reporting on Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand order)
annotation.summary_en: News report on an updated Civil Aviation Authority of Thailand order permitting nationwide drone flights from 1–15 September 2025, subject to registration, three-day advance flight notification, time limits, and bans in border provinces and near key airports. Drone registrations surged after restrictions.
key_provisions_or_claims: All drones must be registered and flight details submitted at least 3 days ahead via CAAT UAS Portal
Flights allowed 6am–6pm; 12:01–4am strictly prohibited; other times need approval
Drones over 25 kg need additional clearance
Drone flights banned in five border provinces and near key airports
Government drones exempt; civil agencies in restricted areas must notify CAAT and Anti-Drone Center
